verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public first-party GitHub repository for the Firebase CLI (firebase/firebase-tools), so some of the product's client tooling source is readable. Nothing in the pack states its license, and nothing shows that the core hosted services (Firestore, Auth, Functions runtime) are source-available. missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license, source availability for the core backend services and SDKs beyond the CLI, independent corroboration of openness.
